BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_Exp:
The Set KO Tourney has special rules, unlike standard battles.

First, one battle lasts only three turns.

If the outcome is not decided after three turns, it goes to judging.

The REFEREE will choose the winner based on how the POKéMON battled.

Also, a POKéMON cannot be switched out until its battle's outcome is decided.

The first judging factor is “Mind.” This factor evaluates how aggressive the battlers were.

The judging is based on how often the TRAINERS ordered the use of offensive moves.

The second judging factor is “Skill.” This factor evaluates how effectively POKéMON moves were used.

If a move worked successfully, the Skill rating goes up.

If a move failed, the Skill rating is lowered.

If it was an offensive move, the Skill rating goes up if the move was “super effective” and goes down if it was “not very effective.”

The Skill rating will not go up for moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.

If the opponent used PROTECT or DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to hit with a move, its Skill rating will not go down.

The third judging factor is “Body.” This factor is based on how much HP remained at the end of a battle.

The rating takes into account how much HP a POKéMON had at the start of battle, and what remained at the end.

BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_Ex:
Here, POKéMON are required to think and battle by themselves.

Unlike in the wild, POKéMON that live with people behave differently depending on their nature.

Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may prefer to attack no matter what.

Another POKéMON may prefer to protect itself from any harm.

Yet another may enjoy vexing or confounding its foes.

Due to its nature, a POKéMON will have favorite moves that it is good at using.

It may also dislike certain moves that it has trouble using.

There are offensive moves that inflict direct damage on the foe.

There are defensive moves that are used to prepare for enemy attacks or used to heal HP and so on.

There are also other somewhat-odd moves that may enfeeble the foes with stat problems including poison and  paralysis.

POKéMON will consider using moves in these three categories.

When not under command by its TRAINER, a POKéMON may be unable to effectively use certain moves.

A POKéMON is not good at using any move that it dislikes.

If a POKéMON only knows moves that do not match its nature, it will often be unable to live up to its potential.

Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may start using moves that don't match its nature when it is in trouble.

If a POKéMON begins behaving oddly in a pinch, watch it carefully.

Route105_Text_LuisPostBattle: If you are drowning, the signal is to wave one arm toward the beach.
Route105_Text_DominikPostBattle:
Why is the sea blue?

I learned about that at the MUSEUM in SLATEPORT, but I forgot.
Route105_Text_PostBattle:
Your body weight is reduced to just one tenth in the water.

That would make me… Whoops! I'm not telling you my weight!
Route105_Text_ImaniPostBattle: I want to be told I'm relaxing to be with. Giggle.
Route105_Text_AndresPostBattle:
I'm sure there are many secrets to be discovered in the world's seas.

I mean to find them all!
Route105_Text_AndresRegister: Huh? I'm so weak, but you're willing to register me in your POKéNAV?
Route105_Text_AndresRematchPostBattle:
I may be weak at battling, but my drive to explore can't be bested.

I will travel the seas all around the world!
Route105_Text_JosuePostBattle: Yeah, for me, the sky is a much better match than the sea.
Route106_Text_ElliotPostBattle: Fishing is the greatest whether it's in the sea or a stream. You agree with me, right?
Route106_Text_ElliotRegister: Fishing's great, but so is battling. If you don't mind, can we meet again?
Route106_Text_ElliotRematchPostBattle: Win or lose, POKéMON are the greatest! You agree with me, right?
Route106_Text_NedPostBattle: Oh, no! I've got this feeling I'll hook a big one!
Route106_Text_DouglasPostBattle: I wouldn't lose in a swim race…
Route106_Text_KylaPostBattle: Drifting along with the waves… I love it! Why don't you give it a try?
Route107_Text_DarrinPostBattle: Floating and being rocked by the waves--it's like sleeping in a plush, comfy bed.
Route107_Text_TonyPostBattle:
I swim the seas with a heart full of dreams…

It's a song! Anyways, I'm swimming some more.
Route107_Text_TonyRegister: You've shocked me to the bone! Well, so you won't forget me…
Route107_Text_TonyRematchPostBattle: What you learn in battle makes you a stronger TRAINER. The waves taught me that.
Route107_Text_DenisePostBattle: A weird saying is getting really trendy at DEWFORD HALL.
Route107_Text_BethPostBattle: I think you're going to keep getting better. I'll go for it, too!
Route107_Text_LisaPostBattle: LISA: Do you have any friends who would go to the beach with you?
Route107_Text_RayPostBattle: RAY: My sister gave me my POKéMON. I raised it, and now it's my important partner!
Route107_Text_CamronPostBattle:
I still have swimming and running left to do after this.

Am I going to be okay?
Route108_Text_JeromePostBattle: Playing with marine POKéMON is one of the pleasures of swimming!
Route108_Text_MatthewPostBattle: Some people even go inside that ABANDONED SHIP.
Route108_Text_TaraPostBattle: Even if it's a lie, I love being told I look great… We girls are so complex…
Route108_Text_MissyPostBattle: Work off your stress by swimming! It's so healthy!
Route108_Text_CoryPostBattle: Shouting is good for me! It uplifts me!
Route108_Text_CoryRegister: I love tough TRAINERS, too! Register me in your POKéNAV!
Route108_Text_CoryRematchPostBattle: If you're faced with a challenge, try shouting at the sea!
Route108_Text_CarolinaPostBattle: Since I'm at sea like this, I wouldn't mind putting on a pink, frilly swimsuit…
Route109_Text_DavidPostBattle:
Hiyah!

My sculpted abs have nothing to do with POKéMON battles!
Route109_Text_AlicePostBattle: Cheeks are the most prone to burning!
Route109_Text_HueyPostBattle: In the best port was the best TRAINER…
Route109_Text_EdmondPostBattle:
I'm usually stronger than this! I'm just seasick as a dog!

I'm a SAILOR, but…
Route109_Text_RickyPostBattle: I'm getting famished… My inner tube looks like a giant doughnut…
Route109_Text_RickyRegister: Will you have another match with me when I'm not all thirsty?
Route109_Text_RickyRematchPostBattle: When you eat on a beach, everything seems to taste a little better.
Route109_Text_LolaPostBattle: If you look at the beach from the sky, it looks like a big flower garden!
Route109_Text_LolaRematchPostBattle: If I have an inner tube, me and my POKéMON's cuteness goes way up!
Route109_Text_AustinaPostBattle: My inner tube is a fashion item. I can't be seen without it.
Route109_Text_GwenPostBattle: How did you get to be so strong?
Route109_Text_CarterPostBattle: This dude thinks you're a big one. No, you're a big-one-to-be!
Route109_Text_PaulPostBattle: PAUL: Well, don't tell anyone that we're here. This is just our private world of two!
Route109_Text_MelPostBattle: MEL: Um, PAUL, are you angry with me? Please don't be angry.
Route109_Text_ChandlerPostBattle: After I showed you my round inner tube, too…
Route109_Text_HaileyPostBattle: When I learn how to swim, I think my POKéMON will become tougher.
Route109_Text_ElijahPostBattle:
For a guy as macho as me, a port is the perfect setting!

I guess I'll head for SLATEPORT.
Route110_Text_JacobPostBattle: Flat tires and brake problems can cause serious injury! Inspect your BIKE for problems!
Route110_Text_AnthonyPostBattle: Speed alone won't let me win at POKéMON. I need to reconsider this…
Route110_Text_BenjaminPostBattle: There's no need to panic or stress. Take it easy. There's plenty of time.
Route110_Text_BenjaminRegister: I'll keep chugging on without stressing. Give me a shout if you're up to it.
Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchPostBattle: There's no need to panic or stress. Take it easy. There's plenty of time.
Route110_Text_AbigailPostBattle: I'm exhausted, so I need a break. It's important to get proper rest.
Route110_Text_AbigailRegister: You know, I like you! Let's have a rematch on CYCLING ROAD.
Route110_Text_AbigailRematchPostBattle:
Were you going after a record?

I'm sorry if I held you up!
Route110_Text_JasminePostBattle: Oh, you have some GYM BADGES? No wonder you're so strong!
Route110_Text_EdwardPostBattle:
I see your future…

Hmm… I see a shining light…
Route110_Text_JaclynPostBattle: You managed to win only because it was a wonder! Yes, a wonder! Don't think you can win all the time!
Route110_Text_EdwinPostBattle: When I see a POKéMON that I don't know, my passion as a collector is ignited!
Route110_Text_EdwinRegister: I like collecting MATCH CALL registrations, too…
Route110_Text_EdwinRematchPostBattle: Oh, I long to make all rare POKéMON mine!
Route110_Text_DalePostBattle: Fishing is all about concentration. You have to focus on the floater.
Route110_Text_IsabelPostBattle: Rather than battling, perhaps I should show off my POKéMON at the FAN CLUB.
Route110_Text_IsabelRegister:
That wasn't close to what I could do to show off my POKéMON.

I'll have you as my captive audience as often as possible!
Route110_Text_IsabelRematchPostBattle:
I don't think that I could ever stop from showing off my POKéMON.

But I like to battle, too!
Route110_Text_TimmyPostBattle: It's hard to battle with POKéMON you just caught.
Route110_Text_AlyssaPostBattle: Falling… Losing… This is so humiliating for me!
Route110_Text_JosephPostBattle: This isn't going to bring me down! Losing has made me a better man!
Route110_Text_KalebPostBattle: Okay, okay, you've done the best you could, my pretties.
Route111_Text_DrewPostBattle: The GO-GOGGLES make it possible to get through sandstorms. That makes me happy!
Route111_Text_HeidiPostBattle:
When you're battling in a sandstorm, watch out for your POKéMON's HP.

It can faint if you don't keep an eye on it!
Route111_Text_BeauPostBattle: I'm going to be a real hero one day. I'm going to work harder to make me and my POKéMON stronger.
Route111_Text_BeckyPostBattle: If they can find fossils in the desert, it must have been a sea before.
Route111_Text_DustyPostBattle:
For thirty years I have searched for ancient ruins!

No, wait, was that forty years? Which was it now?
Route111_Text_DustyRegister:
I haven't been searching for any tough POKéMON.

But, for some reason, I sure do like POKéNAVS.
Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch:
For thirty years I have searched for ancient ruins!

No, wait, was that forty years I've searched?

Hmm… It could even be fifty… How long have I been at this?
Route111_Text_TravisPostBattle: When I see a TRAINER with a lot of pep, I can't help looking.
Route111_Text_IrenePostBattle: I'm thinking that I should go to MT. CHIMNEY, but the view around here is very nice, too.
Route111_Text_DaisukePostBattle: All I can do is keep training until I can defeat strong TRAINERS such as yourself.
Route111_Text_WiltonPostBattle:
POKéMON and TRAINERS learn much through battling.

What's important is to never give up even if you lose.
Route111_Text_WiltonRegister:
There is much to be learned from your training style.

I request a rematch if it behooves you.
Route111_Text_WiltonPostRematch: Since you're that strong, you should aim for the POKéMON LEAGUE.
Route111_Text_BrookePostBattle: I thought I was raising my POKéMON diligently, but, oh no, there is still much to be done.
Route111_Text_BrookeRegister: I wish I could become friends with more strong people like you!
Route111_Text_BrookePostRematch: Maybe I should have stopped my POKéMON from evolving until they learned better moves…
Route111_Text_CeliaPostBattle: In a sandstorm like this, I can't set the places for a picnic even with my GO-GOGGLES on…
Route111_Text_BryanPostBattle: This desert hoards mysteries in its shifting sands!
Route111_Text_BrandenPostBattle: My SANDSHREW loves eating my sandwiches.
Route111_Text_TyronPostBattle:
When having a battle, I get a kick out of showing off my POKéMON.

I bet everyone feels that way when they enter a battle!
Route111_Text_CelinaPostBattle: My pulse is still racing. You're one fabulous TRAINER.
Route111_Text_HaydenPostBattle: My stomach is grumbling! Maybe I can grill some BERRIES…
Route111_Text_BiancaPostBattle: This road here… You have quite a ways to travel.
Route112_Text_BricePostBattle: Hahahahaha! Something flew up my nose! Hahahaha-hatchoo!
Route112_Text_TrentPostBattle:
Try hiking, and I mean really pounding, on these mountain trails with a heavy pack weighing dozens of pounds.

That, my friend, will get your body into serious shape.
Route112_Text_TrentRegister:
Ow, my legs have cramped up. Can you grab me some bandages from my backpack?

No, that's my POKéNAV! Oh, fine, I'll register you.
Route112_Text_TrentRematchPostBattle:
I hear there are some seriously tough TRAINERS on top of MT. CHIMNEY.

I intend to get up there and give them a challenge!
Route112_Text_LarryPostBattle: I'm not crying because I miss my mommy! Snivel…
Route112_Text_CarolPostBattle:
It doesn't matter if you're good or bad at singing or POKéMON.

If you have the most fun, you win!
Route112_Text_BryantPostBattle: I like the way you battle. It has a certain flair to it.
Route112_Text_ShaylaPostBattle: Are you busy right now? I was thinking that maybe we can have a rematch right now… But it's all right if you're busy.
Route113_Text_JaylenPostBattle:
The volcanic ash blocks the sun, so it doesn't get very warm.

That's good for me--I can't stand heat!
Route113_Text_DillonPostBattle:
Ouch! Owww! I can't see! I got ashes in my eyelashes!

Get it? Ashes and eyelashes?

Okay, that was bad, sorry…
Route113_Text_MadelinePostBattle: You're very good at this. I must say I'm impressed!
Route113_Text_MadelineRegister: Here, slide under my parasol. Let me register you in my POKéNAV.
Route113_Text_MadelinePostRematch: You've remained very good at this. I must say I'm impressed!
Route113_Text_LaoPostBattle: I must refine the art of concealment. I bid thee farewell.
Route113_Text_LaoRegister: Yiiyaah! Witness the ancient ninja technique of POKéNAV registration!
Route113_Text_LaoPostRematch:
My flawless concealment was let down by my immature battle skills…

I bid thee farewell.
Route113_Text_LungPostBattle: You know what's crummy about hiding? It's lonely if no one comes along.
Route113_Text_ToriPostBattle: TORI: How much ash do we have? Enough for a WHITE FLUTE, I hope.
Route113_Text_TiaPostBattle: TIA: We have a lot of ashes! I think enough for a WHITE FLUTE!
Route113_Text_CobyPostBattle: I don't know what to say when I get beaten so easily…
Route113_Text_SophiePostBattle: Losing burns me up… I'm just going to sleep right here! Zzz!
Route113_Text_LawrencePostBattle: I ought to hide under the ashes, too.
Route113_Text_WyattPostBattle:
Oh, so now you want to say a word to the loser?

Aren't you just the coolest? Humph!
Route114_Text_LennyPostBattle: When I was a wee tyke, I believed there was someone copying me and shouting back, “Yodelayhihoo.”
Route114_Text_LucasPostBattle: In the winter, mountains turn deadly with blizzards and avalanches.
Route114_Text_ShanePostBattle: I think it's great that I can go camping with my POKéMON.
Route114_Text_NancyPostBattle: I just had a tasty meal. I'm getting drowsy…
Route114_Text_StevePostBattle:
A big body that's all lumpy and hard, enormous horns, and vicious fangs…

Ufufufufu… I wish I had a POKéMON like that…
Route114_Text_SteveRegister: Don't forget what you've done to me! I'll make it so you can't forget!
Route114_Text_StevePostRematch:
Ufufufufufu…

When I see POKéMON battling, I get all shivery and shaky…
Route114_Text_BerniePostBattle:
You really do have to be careful with any sort of fire in a forest.

Don't ever underestimate the power of fire.
Route114_Text_BernieRegister: You set my spirit on fire. Let's register each other!
Route114_Text_BerniePostRematch:
You really do have to be careful with any sort of fire in a forest.

Don't ever underestimate the power of fire.
Route114_Text_ClaudePostBattle:
I think I'll try my luck at landing a big one at METEOR FALLS.

There has to be something in there. I just know it.
Route114_Text_NolanPostBattle:
This time I'll do it!

I always think that, so I can't walk away from fishing or POKéMON.
Route114_Text_TyraPostBattle: TYRA: I was teaching my junior IVY about POKéMON.
Route114_Text_IvyPostBattle: IVY: I started training POKéMON because TYRA, my student mentor, taught me!
Route114_Text_KaiPostBattle: Okay! I'll just fish me a bigger one!
Route114_Text_CharlottePostBattle:
I don't want a POKéMON that's just cute.

I adore cute ones that have a quirk or two!
Route114_Text_AngelinaPostBattle: Some POKéMON change so much when they evolve, it's startling!
Route115_Text_TimothyPostBattle: There is no such thing as a born genius. It all depends on effort! That is what I believe…
Route115_Text_TimothyRegister:
Hmm… A loss this thorough has been a distant memory.

If you would allow it, I wish for another opportunity to do battle.
Route115_Text_TimothyPostRematch:
All it takes is effort!

I lost because I haven't put in enough effort!
Route115_Text_KoichiPostBattle:
My MACHOP crew!

So long as they seek power, I will grow strong with them!
Route115_Text_NobPostBattle:
I've been teaching my POKéMON karate.

It looks like they'll get a lot better than me. I'm excited about that.
Route115_Text_NobRegister: You impress me! Give me a rematch after I redo my training!
Route115_Text_NobPostRematch: My POKéMON will grow stronger! I'll redouble my training!
Route115_Text_CyndyPostBattle: The sand acts as a cushion to reduce impact and prevent injury. This is the perfect place to train.
Route115_Text_CyndyRegister: Okay, fine, you're free to come here. In return, I'd like to battle you again.
Route115_Text_CyndyPostRematch: Even when I lose, I still get some enjoyment out of it. It must be that I love POKéMON.
Route115_Text_HectorPostBattle: I have this rare POKéMON. It's enough to keep me satisfied.
Route115_Text_KyraPostBattle:
I made the mistake of trying to battle while running!

I should take a run to calm down…
Route115_Text_JaidenPostBattle: But my POKéMON were ultra, weren't they?
Route115_Text_HelenePostBattle:
I rarely meet anyone who's better than me…

I get it now! You're a GYM LEADER, aren't you?
Route115_Text_AlixPostBattle: Oh, well. I think I will TELEPORT home.
Route115_Text_MarlenePostBattle: I was meditating with my POKéMON. But this place isn't very peaceful…
Route116_Text_ClarkPostBattle: It's no big deal if there's no tunnel. To a HIKER, mountains are roads!
Route116_Text_JoeyPostBattle: Bandages are signs of toughness! I've got another one!
Route116_Text_JosePostBattle: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly. So they get strong quickly, too.
Route116_Text_JanicePostBattle: POKéMON that possess cuteness and power, that's ideal, I think.
Route116_Text_JerryPostBattle: I'll have to redo some courses at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL. If I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.
Route116_Text_JerryRegister1:
I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL that a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.

I don't really get what that means, so can I just try it?
Route116_Text_JerryRegister2:
I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL that a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.

I don't really get what that means, so can I just try it?
Route116_Text_JerryPostRematch: I'll have to redo some courses at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL. If I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.
Route116_Text_KarenPostBattle: Awww, I'll never become an elegant TRAINER like ROXANNE this way!
Route116_Text_KarenRegister1: Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV? I have one, too! Please register me!
Route116_Text_KarenRegister2: Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV? I have one, too! Please register me!
Route116_Text_KarenPostRematch: You've beaten ROXANNE? I can't beat you, then. Not yet.
Route116_Text_SarahPostBattle:
My life of luxury affords me all that I could possibly desire.

However, when it comes to POKéMON, my wealth has no meaning.
Route116_Text_DawsonPostBattle: Oh, no, no, no! You've mussed up my POKéMON's fur! You've ruined my hairdo, too! I'll have to call my stylist now!
Route116_Text_DevanPostBattle: I should try different POKéMON types, that's what I ought to do.
Route116_Text_JohnsonPostBattle: Want to stay here and keep me company?
Route117_Text_IsaacPostBattle:
POKéMON isn't all about power.

Polishing a unique aspect of one's character is another way of enjoying POKéMON.
Route117_Text_IsaacRegister: I'm going to redouble my training. Would you come look in on us?
Route117_Text_IsaacPostRematch: Your POKéMON are growing good! You should enter them in CONTESTS.
Route117_Text_LydiaPostBattle: Try raising POKéMON with more attention to their character traits.
Route117_Text_LydiaRegister: I'm glad I met a superb TRAINER in you. I hope to see you again.
Route117_Text_LydiaPostRematch: POKéMON seem to like different kinds of {POKEBLOCK}S, depending on their nature.
Route117_Text_DylanPostBattle:
I may have blown it…

I might have dropped to last during that battle…
Route117_Text_DylanRegister: POKéMON have to be strong, too? I'd like you to train me!
Route117_Text_DylanPostRematch: I was tops in swimming and cycling, but I'm not quite that confident with POKéMON yet.
Route117_Text_MariaPostBattle:
Training is meaningful only if you keep it up regularly.

Okay! I'll resume my training! Tomorrow!
Route117_Text_MariaRegister: You appear to be training properly… If you'd like, I'll battle you later!
Route117_Text_MariaPostRematch: I'll resume training tomorrow. Let's battle again sometime!
Route117_Text_DerekPostBattle:
All I did was follow my heart, and now they call me a BUG MANIAC…

Still, I am an expert on BUG POKéMON, so it's only natural that they call me a BUG MANIAC.
Route117_Text_AnnaPostBattle:
ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good combinations.

I'd say you're second only to us!
Route117_Text_AnnaAndMegRegister: ANNA: We can't take this lying down! You will come back, won't you?
Route117_Text_MegPostBattle: MEG: I dragged ANNA down… If I didn't, she would have won!
Route117_Text_AnnaPostRematch:
ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good combinations.

I'd say you're second only to us!
Route117_Text_MegPostRematch:
MEG: I battled together with my senior partner, but we lost…

That's so discouraging…
Route117_Text_MelinaPostBattle: It feels wonderful to go for a jog while looking at flowers.
Route117_Text_BrandiPostBattle: PSYCHIC POKéMON are complex. You should try catching some.
Route117_Text_AishaPostBattle: I think that if you worry about losing, you're more likely to lose.
Route118_Text_RosePostBattle:
Flowers, POKéMON… I love whatever smells nice.

Stinky things… I'll pass.
Route118_Text_RoseRegister: Sniff… That odor--it's a POKéNAV! We must register each other!
Route118_Text_RosePostRematch: If you use a sweet aroma properly, POKéMON will be attracted by it.
Route118_Text_PerryPostBattle: You've got great POKéMON. I'll have to train mine better.
Route118_Text_ChesterPostBattle: If they'd get stronger, they'd be able to fly more freely…
Route118_Text_BarnyPostBattle:
I couldn't win by training POKéMON while I fished…

Was I doing things in half measures?
Route118_Text_WadePostBattle: Come to think of it, fishing is a battle between a FISHERMAN and a POKéMON.
Route118_Text_DaltonPostBattle:
An electric guitar doesn't always have to be noisy…

It can be strummed to squeeze out this heart-stirring melody…
Route118_Text_DaltonRegister: When I compose better melodies, you have to come listen, okay?
Route118_Text_DaltonPostRematch: When I play, my emotions should reach you through my electric guitar…
Route118_Text_DeandrePostBattle:
Isn't it cool that I have a POKéMON battle team?

You can copy me--I don't mind!
Route119_Text_BrentPostBattle:
What's so good about mimicry?

Fufufu… You'll never understand…
Route119_Text_DonaldPostBattle: I want to MIMIC you some more. Can you hurry up and move?
Route119_Text_TaylorPostBattle: I can't MIMIC you winning the match. That's just impossible… It's burning me up…
Route119_Text_DougPostBattle: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE! I hope you enjoyed our performance.
Route119_Text_GregPostBattle: Until you go away somewhere, we'll keep on mimicking your every move.
Route119_Text_KentPostBattle: Won't you join our MIMIC CIRCLE?
Route119_Text_JacksonPostBattle:
To break away from civilization and awaken the wild spirit within!

That's our vision.
Route119_Text_JacksonRegister: I hope you'll give me a rematch without mocking my lack of knowledge.
Route119_Text_JacksonPostRematch:
Believe in your POKéMON. Believe in yourself.

The road will reveal itself to you.
Route119_Text_CatherinePostBattle:
You're traveling light but you have everything you need.

You're on top of things mentally and physically, too.
Route119_Text_CatherineRegister:
Do you have a POKéNAV? It's a must-have tool for any TRAINER.

Oh, you do have one! Let's register each other, then!
Route119_Text_CatherinePostRematch: In the same way that you, as a TRAINER, rely on your POKéMON, your POKéMON rely on you.
Route119_Text_HughPostBattle: My BIRD POKéMON made my dreams of flying come true!
Route119_Text_PhilPostBattle: Ever since I was a little kid, I always admired BIRD POKéMON…
Route119_Text_YasuPostBattle: Those defeated in battle withdraw quietly back into the shadows. That, too, is destiny…
Route119_Text_TakashiPostBattle: My surprise attack ended in failure…
Route119_Text_HideoPostBattle:
To hide a tree, use a forest! To hide a POKéMON, use a POKéMON!

There is no deep, hidden meaning to that.
Route119_Text_ChrisPostBattle:
Go for a SURF on my POKéMON…

Then fish off its back…

It's an indescribably luxuriant moment!
Route119_Text_FabianPostBattle: Hit me with another power chord! Leave me alone! Your win you have to atone!
Route119_Text_DaytonPostBattle: Hohoho! I'll try emulating the pep of kid TRAINERS like you!
Route119_Text_RachelPostBattle: You're asking if my parasol is heavy? Your BAG is filled with more junk than I ever carry around.
Route120_Text_ColinPostBattle:
The move FLY is convenient, don't you think?

While the POKéMON is flying, almost no moves can strike it.
Route120_Text_RobertPostBattle: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one you can count on.
Route120_Text_RobertRegister: You can be counted on to get better. I'd like to register you in my POKéNAV!
Route120_Text_RobertPostRematch: My POKéMON are growing stronger. I have to grow stronger, too.
Route120_Text_LorenzoPostBattle: To travel wherever your heart desires with POKéMON… That's the joy of being a TRAINER.
Route120_Text_JennaPostBattle: Fitness training is in my routine. I always run with my POKéMON.
Route120_Text_JeffreyPostRematch: … … … … … … … … … … … … I'll try harder… For my precious BUG POKéMON…
Route120_Text_JenniferPostBattle: The special abilities of POKéMON will make battle styles change.
Route120_Text_ChipPostBattle: That giant rock… I would like to believe it may indeed contain ancient ruins. But I see no entrance.
Route120_Text_ClarissaPostBattle: I don't think strong sunlight is good for my POKéMON. So I shield them with my parasol.
Route120_Text_AngelicaPostBattle:
A parasol wouldn't suit you at all.

Why, something like this would only get in your way.
Route120_Text_KeigoPostBattle: Perhaps I ought to apprentice under a ninja sensei.
Route120_Text_RileyPostBattle: Our camouflage cloaks are all handmade.
Route120_Text_CalliePostBattle: I wonder… Should I evolve my POKéMON? They're cute the way they are, though.
Route120_Text_LeonelPostBattle: I think it's awesome you're so strong battling with your favorite POKéMON.
Route121_Text_VanessaPostBattle:
I'm going to a CONTEST in LILYCOVE.

My POKéMON should have no problem sweeping the MASTER CLASS.
Route121_Text_WalterPostBattle: I would like to circle the globe once again with my POKéMON.
Route121_Text_WalterRegister: Your POKéMON prowess is remarkable. Allow me to register you as a memento.
Route121_Text_WalterPostRematch:
Your POKéMON and you…

Your prowess together will be considered strong, even overseas.
Route121_Text_TammyPostBattle: MT. PYRE… There is a mysterious power at work there…
Route121_Text_KatePostBattle: KATE: When someone's relying on me, I get this urge to look cool in front of them…
Route121_Text_JoyPostBattle: JOY: Ehehe, I'll have to train with KATE, my senior student partner, again.
Route121_Text_JessicaPostBattle: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at the SAFARI.
Route121_Text_JessicaRegister: I took it easy on you this time! It won't be that way the next time!
Route121_Text_JessicaPostRematch: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at the SAFARI.
Route121_Text_CristinPostBattle: I didn't expect to lose this easily… I'll win next time!
Route121_Text_CristinRegister: That was total humiliation! I won't forget you… Hand over your POKéNAV!
Route121_Text_CristinPostRematch: An opponent I just can't beat… Snivel… I can't believe this is happening…
Route121_Text_CalePostBattle:
I bought too much stuff at the LILYCOVE DEPT. STORE.

It's up the road from here. I wish I had a BAG like yours.
Route121_Text_MylesPostBattle: They're great, your POKéMON! How do you raise them?
Route121_Text_PatPostBattle: I raise every POKéMON with the same love and care--I don't pick favorites.
Route121_Text_MarcelPostBattle: I may have to train my gang some more before entering any CONTEST.
Route123_Text_WendyPostBattle: To best even me… Your strength is marvelous!
Route123_Text_BraxtonPostBattle: You did your BADGES proud in that match!
Route123_Text_VioletPostBattle: The BERRY MASTER's garden is filled with uplifting fragrances.
Route123_Text_CameronPostBattle: Being a psychic is about willpower. I thought I wouldn't lose to you…
Route123_Text_CameronRegister:
I sense it! You and I shall battle again! I can't tell if I'll win, though…

Let's see your POKéNAV.
Route123_Text_CameronPostRematch: I should train at MT. PYRE… I'll never beat you this way…
Route123_Text_JackiPostBattle: We all have psychic powers. We've just forgotten how to use them.
Route123_Text_JackiRegister: I would like to face you again. Is that okay with you?
Route123_Text_JackiPostRematch: Your power with POKéMON… That could be a psychic power, too.
Route123_Text_MiuPostBattle: MIU: TRAINER, your POKéMON are strong because you are friends.
Route123_Text_YukiPostBattle: YUKI: Why are you so strong? We've never lost before.
Route123_Text_KindraPostBattle:
MT. PYRE… Where the spirits of POKéMON sleep…

It must overflow with a power that soothes spirits…
Route123_Text_FernandoPostBattle: You're rock steady. I'd like to write a tune about you.
Route123_Text_FernandoRegister: The next time, lend your ears to the full tune, will you?
Route123_Text_FernandoPostRematch: I thought you'd be so enthralled by my tune, you'd lose.
Route123_Text_DavisPostBattle: Don't tell my brother I lost. You have to keep it a secret!
Route123_Text_JazmynPostBattle:
They say that you can't judge a person by their appearance.

But often, their looks don't lie…
Route123_Text_FrederickPostBattle: Contribute to your allowance? Wasn't the prize money enough?
Route123_Text_AlbertoPostBattle:
I gather BIRD POKéMON feathers that scatter during battles.

I'm going to make a hat with BIRD POKéMON feathers.
Route123_Text_EdPostBattle: Hehe, I'm swiping your battling ideas! I think they'll make me better.
Route123_Text_JonasPostBattle: I'm going to ambush a weaker-looking TRAINER next time.
Route123_Text_KayleyPostBattle: Using accessories effectively is the secret behind fashion appeal.
Route124_Text_SpencerPostBattle:
Many people lose their bearings at sea.

If you're that sort, you should refer to the POKéNAV's MAP.
Route124_Text_RolandPostBattle:
I'm getting chilled… I've been in the water too long…

I wish I could ride a POKéMON like you…
Route124_Text_JennyPostBattle:
While swimming, I noticed that some POKéMON attack, and some just watch.

I guess POKéMON have personalities of their own.
Route124_Text_JennyRegister: It's only on a whim, but maybe I'll get you to register me in your POKéNAV.
Route124_Text_JennyPostRematch: This has nothing to do with anything, but maybe I'll visit the TRICK HOUSE.
Route124_Text_GracePostBattle: All the effort you put in must have made you this strong.
Route124_Text_ChadPostBattle:
I have it on good authority that there's a DIVE spot around here.

It gives me the urge to go deep again…
Route124_Text_LilaPostBattle:
LILA: Sigh…

If only it wasn't my little brother next to me, but a nice boyfriend…
Route124_Text_RoyPostBattle:
ROY: My big sister is really scary when she gets angry.

That's why she doesn't have a boyfriend.
Route124_Text_LilaRoyRegister: ROY: Will you battle with us again? But take it easy next time, okay?
Route124_Text_LilaPostRematch:
LILA: Sigh…

If I had a nice boyfriend, we'd beat anyone with lovely combinations…
Route124_Text_RoyPostRematch:
ROY: My big sister is really scary when she gets angry.

She's going to make me train really hard with POKéMON later…
Route124_Text_DeclanPostBattle: I should chat up lady SWIMMERS and invite them on a long swim.
Route124_Text_IsabellaPostBattle: You can find pretty colored shards of things around here.
Route125_Text_NolenPostBattle: Sound travels faster in water than it does through air.
Route125_Text_StanPostBattle: I was blown away by HORSEA's charm, so I started swimming, too.
Route125_Text_TanyaPostBattle: Whew… Which way is it to MOSSDEEP CITY?
Route125_Text_SharonPostBattle: Your power… You're the real deal. I'm amazed!
Route125_Text_ErnestPostBattle:
The tide ebbs and flows inside the SHOAL CAVE.

By the way, it's about six hours from high tide to low tide. Did you know?
Route125_Text_ErnestRegister: Register me in your POKéNAV, and I'll tell you something good.
Route125_Text_ErnestRematchPostBattle:
The SHOAL CAVE…

There are places you can and can't get to depending on the rise and fall of the tide.

By the way, it's about six hours from high tide to low tide. Don't forget!
Route125_Text_KimPostBattle:
KIM: A funny old man lives in the SHOAL CAVE, doesn't he?

Let's go see him, IRIS!
Route125_Text_IrisPostBattle: IRIS: KIM, are we really going into the SHOAL CAVE? We'll get all wet.
Route125_Text_PresleyPostBattle:
I put a message in a bottle and put it out to sea.

I'm sure that a girl SWIMMER will find it!
Route125_Text_AuronPostBattle:
I found an unsightly bottle bobbing in the waves earlier.

It angers me that someone would pollute the sea!
Route126_Text_BarryPostBattle: Thanks to my daily swimming routine… Look! Feast your eyes on this physique!
Route126_Text_DeanPostBattle: I can't find the entrance to SOOTOPOLIS. Where could it be?
Route126_Text_NikkiPostBattle: You thrashed me… I want to disappear in a wave of despair…
Route126_Text_BrendaPostBattle: I love frolicking with POKéMON in the sea like this!
Route126_Text_PabloPostBattle: Losing to you stimulated my senses! I'll train myself and POKéMON harder!
Route126_Text_PabloRegister: Yep, you're not bad at all! I'd like to get to know you more!
Route126_Text_PabloPostRematch: I'm going to train even harder! You're a great motivator! You have to come back again!
Route126_Text_LeonardoPostBattle:
If you practice at something, you will get better at it.

You're young--don't be afraid to try all sorts of things!
Route126_Text_IsobelPostBattle: Ooh, I choked on some water! It's bitter! It's salty!!
Route126_Text_SiennaPostBattle: I need to cool down now… I think I'll go for a dive.
Route127_Text_CamdenPostBattle: A well-played match leaves me feeling refreshed and serene.
Route127_Text_DonnyPostBattle: If you have a rival, don't you get the feeling that you have to keep getting better?
Route127_Text_JonahPostBattle: It matters not that I catch nothing. The line remains in the water…
Route127_Text_HenryPostBattle: It'd be a handful if I hooked your tough POKéMON!
Route127_Text_RogerPostBattle: My fishing line's doing a dance! The tangle tango! Hahaha, snarl!
Route127_Text_AidanPostBattle:
There're lots of diving spots in the sea around here.

You can spot them easily from the sky because of their darker color.
Route127_Text_KojiPostBattle: Going barefoot feels great. But your RUNNING SHOES are cool, too.
Route127_Text_KojiRegister: This is what I do to people who beat me! I hope we can do this again.
Route127_Text_KojiPostRematch: Want to go barefoot for a while? So I can try your RUNNING SHOES?
Route127_Text_AthenaPostBattle: When I'm surrounded by the blue sea and sky, it feels as if time slows down.
Route128_Text_IsaiahPostBattle: My whole life has been about losing, but I will never give up!
Route128_Text_IsaiahRegister:
I know I'm not good now, but I think I can win eventually.

Please register me in your POKéNAV.
Route128_Text_IsaiahPostRematch: I'll eventually reach EVER GRANDE CITY where I can eventually win…
Route128_Text_KatelynPostBattle: I have to ride a BIKE next, but… I'm about to throw in the towel…
Route128_Text_KatelynRegister: Well, I may as well make the best of this. I'd like a rematch sometime.
Route128_Text_KatelynPostRematch: You should give serious thought to challenges on VICTORY ROAD.
Route128_Text_AlexaPostBattle: After all I've done to get here, I won't give up after one setback.
Route128_Text_RubenPostBattle: There probably is no stronger TRAINER than you!
Route128_Text_WaynePostBattle:
Awww, phooey!

My POKéMON knows WATERFALL, but I don't have the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!
Route128_Text_HarrisonPostBattle:
There are tough TRAINERS galore around EVER GRANDE.

Do you think I may be out of my league?
Route128_Text_CarleePostBattle: I should go back soon. I need to reapply my sunscreen.
Route129_Text_ChasePostBattle: If I'm all tensed up, I won't be able to give it my all.
Route129_Text_AllisonPostBattle:
Do you know what's the greatest thing about triathlons?

Testing the limits of your own strength and endurance against Mother Nature!
Route129_Text_ReedPostBattle: There's nothing for a loser. Time for me to beat it home.
Route129_Text_TishaPostBattle:
Don't you hate making mistakes when you're in a rush?

That's why I try to take things slowly.
Route129_Text_ClarencePostBattle: You have your sights on the POKéMON LEAGUE? Keep at it!
Route130_Text_RodneyPostBattle: Your eyes have that look of someone who's experienced harsh challenges and won. It suits you well!
Route130_Text_KatiePostBattle: The world's children dream of one day becoming the POKéMON CHAMPION.
Route130_Text_SantiagoPostBattle: Swimming and battling like this… I'm one happy guy…
Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle:
Gasp… Gasp… I'm wiped out…

The going's easy. It's the leaving that's the hard part.

Will I have any energy left to make the return trip?
Route131_Text_HermanPostBattle:
Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must.

I'm a born swimmer! That's what I am.
Route131_Text_SusiePostBattle:
Did you see a guy over there who whines that he's bored of the sea?

That's all talk. He's hopelessly in love with the sea!
Route131_Text_KaraPostBattle: Maybe it's not my bathing suit that makes men look. It must be my beauty!
Route131_Text_ReliPostBattle: RELI: The people of PACIFIDLOG are together with the sea and POKéMON from the time they are born.
Route131_Text_IanPostBattle:
IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is a floating town?

So, wherever there is the sea, that's a part of PACIFIDLOG!
Route131_Text_TaliaPostBattle: There is an odd place nearby. There's a huge tower there. Why don't you go take a look?
Route131_Text_KevinPostBattle:
Tch! …Oh, wait. I'm not angry. Honestly!

But, boy, you're strong! Hahaha!
Route132_Text_GilbertPostBattle: TRAINERS travel the fields and mountains, so they must be fit, too.
Route132_Text_DanaPostBattle: If I get swept away, I'll lose all my sense of place…
Route132_Text_RonaldPostBattle: I never battle when I know I'll win. I like to battle at the razor's edge of victory and defeat!
Route132_Text_KiyoPostBattle:
Urggh… You're a POKéMON fanatic, aren't you?

You must contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day, don't you?
Route132_Text_MakaylaPostBattle:
That young man over there looks just like my husband when he was young.

He's making me blush!
Route132_Text_JonathanPostBattle:
I can't shake this feeling that someone's watching me.

I can't concentrate!
Route132_Text_PaxtonPostBattle: My wife must be looking for me. I'd best go find her right away.
Route132_Text_DarcyPostBattle: I suppose I can partner up with that old man and challenge that other team.
Route133_Text_FranklinPostBattle: It's just my luck that a tough TRAINER like you would drift here… I must be cursed…
Route133_Text_DebraPostBattle: A life adrift… I don't want it anymore!
Route133_Text_LindaPostBattle: A strong child TRAINER… That's so annoying!
Route133_Text_WarrenPostBattle: It's way more fun to do things the way I want than to be like everybody else. I mean, that's obvious!
Route133_Text_BeckPostBattle: I'd like to go back to FORTREE, but I've grown to like this place, too.
Route133_Text_MolliePostBattle: Keep at this, youngster. So you can become like my husband and me.
Route133_Text_ConorPostBattle: Don't let others lead you astray. Don't lose direction as you grow older.
Route134_Text_JackPostBattle: I think POKéMON enjoy the fast-running currents around these parts.
Route134_Text_LaurelPostBattle: There's a collector who's after the SCALES of LUVDISC.
Route134_Text_AlexPostBattle: My BIRD POKéMON get tired quickly after a long flight…
Route134_Text_HitoshiPostBattle: It was I who challenged you, and yet I lost. I am deeply shamed…
Route134_Text_AaronPostBattle:
We will return for more training at METEOR FALLS.

If you'd like, you should go, too. It will definitely toughen you up!
Route134_Text_KelvinPostBattle:
If we can't SURF, how are we supposed to get home?

Actually, I know a fainted POKéMON can still SURF, but it feels wrong.
Route134_Text_MarleyPostBattle: I haven't lost my passion for speed. I will try harder.
Route134_Text_ReynaPostBattle:
Haha! You won, all right!

I'll work my way back up by taking on TRAINERS I happen to meet!
Route134_Text_HudsonPostBattle:
Our boat drifted out to sea.

My buddy's a timid fellow, so I'm worried about him.
